title: India: BigMint's low-grade iron ore export index falls w-o-w as weak demand stalls trade
dek: BigMint reports that its index for Indian low-grade iron ore exports fell week on week, with weak demand stalling trade.
summary: According to BigMint, its low-grade iron ore export index for India fell week on week. The publisher attributes the decline to weak demand stalling trade. The excerpt does not give index levels, the size of the fall or destination markets.
keyFacts: BigMint's low-grade iron ore export index for India fell week on week
Weak demand is stalling trade, according to the headline
whyItMatters: Low-grade ore exports are an outlet for Indian miners' fines, so softer overseas demand could leave more material in the domestic market. That could matter for pellet makers and steel mills buying ore locally.
implications: Miners and traders may face pressure on export realisations and could redirect cargoes domestically. Domestic buyers should watch whether this eases local fines prices.
